lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One month since the burnt espresso. Same café, same weird hours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They're at the counter holding two cups. One of them is yours.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: A month of putting up with dispatch schedules. I counted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One month since the burnt espresso. They're at the counter, two cups.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You could buy out this whole café now. You liked it better when you couldn't.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: A month of putting up with dispatch schedules. I counted.

choices.label: Felt like a year. Good year.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Somebody has to keep records around here. You're always on shift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They slide your cup over. Your exact order. They never asked; they learned.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: So. Best moment of the month. Go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They laugh into their coffee. The window light does its thing.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I think a month deserves something. Your call, operator.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The flower stand outside. The window table. The espresso machine, hissing.

choices.label: Claim 'your' table by the window, forever.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The flower stand guy says 'the usual?' You've been planning this a week.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I'm carrying these home like a trophy. Don't look at me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You write 'RESERVED — weird hours only' on a napkin. Prop it on the window table.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The barista laminates it the next day. It's official, then.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Two burnt espressos. To bad coffee and good timing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paper cups touch like champagne glasses. A siren passes — not yours tonight.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Same time next month?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You don't have to answer. You both already know.
